text: Create and manage Git repositories, browse commit history and files, manage branches
quote: Gitea supports creating and managing repositories, browsing commit history and code files, reviewing and merging code submissions, managing collaborators, handling branches, and more.

text: Manage collaborators and access to repositories
quote: Gitea supports creating and managing repositories, browsing commit history and code files, reviewing and merging code submissions, managing collaborators, handling branches, and more.

text: Built-in CI/CD system (Gitea Actions) compatible with GitHub Actions syntax
quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.

text: Reuse existing GitHub Actions-compatible plugins in pipelines
quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.

text: Supports pull request workflow and AGit workflow for proposing and merging changes
quote: Code review supports both the Pull Request workflow and AGit workflow. Reviewers can browse code online and provide review comments or feedback.

text: Reviewers can browse code online and leave inline review comments
quote: Code review supports both the Pull Request workflow and AGit workflow. Reviewers can browse code online and provide review comments or feedback.

text: Provides a documented API to extend and automate Gitea functionality
quote: Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.

text: Supports webhooks for custom workflow integrations
quote: Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.

text: Hosts over 20 types of package registries (npm, Maven, Cargo, Docker/Container, etc.)
quote: Gitea supports over 20 different types of public or private software package management, including Cargo, Chef, Composer, Conan, Conda, Container, Helm, Maven, npm, NuGet, Pub, PyPI, RubyGems, Vagrant, and more.

text: Issue tracker supports milestones, time tracking, due dates, and dependencies
quote: Gitea tracks project requirements, features, and bugs through columns and issues. Issues support features like branches, tags, milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates, dependencies, and more.

text: Organizes work into project boards/columns alongside issues
quote: Gitea tracks project requirements, features, and bugs through columns and issues. Issues support features like branches, tags, milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates, dependencies, and more.

text: Provides user permission management and access control lists for security
quote: Gitea places a strong emphasis on security, offering features such as user permission management, access control lists, and more to ensure the security of code and data.

text: Integrates with chat tools like Slack, Discord, MS Teams, and Lark for notifications
quote: Sync seamlessly with tools like Slack, Discord, MS Teams, Lark, and more.

text: Can be deployed easily on various servers without complex configuration or dependencies
quote: It can be easily deployed on various servers without complex configurations or dependencies.

text: Runs across multiple operating systems (Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, Kubernetes) and architectures (x86, arm64)
quote: Universally compatible with diverse operating systems and environments, including Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, and Kubernetes. Compatible with multiple architectures, such as x86 and arm64.
